ns2:section.sectionText: Following the add/drop policies in the university’s Student Code, undergraduates may switch from 3 to 4 hours or from 4 to 3 hours up until the drop deadline, as noted in the academic calendar: https://registrar.illinois.edu/academic-calendars/. After that, the CS department will not approve late credit-hour changes except under “extraordinary circumstances beyond a student’s control.” https://registrar.illinois.edu/registration/registration-process/variable-credit-hours/ For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/CSregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for BS:Computer Engineering -UIUC.
